name: mf-home
description: Hybrid Home micro frontend — this app has a DUAL NATURE. It is simultaneously a Module Federation remote (exposes modules via webpack's ModuleFederationPlugin) AND a single-spa application (exports bootstrap/mount/unmount lifecycle hooks). The Hybrid shell loads this app's code via Module Federation and manages its lifecycle via single-spa. When running standalone (npm start), it behaves as a normal React app for local development.
